question: Which of the following books has been written by the Booker Prize winner Kiran Desai?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **The Inheritance of Loss.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kiran Desai**, a celebrated Booker Prize winner, is renowned for her literary contributions, with **"The Inheritance of Loss"** being one of her most acclaimed works.
 
• This novel, set against** the backdrop of the Nepalese insurgency in the Indian Himalayas,** intricately explores themes of globalization, nationalism, and the complex dynamics of love and loss.
 
• **Desai's **adept storytelling & rich narrative depth in this book not only secured her the prestigious **Booker Prize** but also solidified her position as a significant voice in contemporary literature.
 
• This accolade highlights the novel's global recognition & its profound impact on the literary world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** A Fine Balance -**

 
 
• It tells the story of four unlikely people whose lives come together during a time of political turmoil soon after the government declares a “State of Internal Emergency.”
 
• Through days of bleakness and hope, their circumstances – and their fates – become inextricably linked in ways no one could have foreseen.
 
 
 
• **The Year of Runaways - **
 
 
• The Year of the Runaways is bestselling author Sunjeev Sahota's second novel. Published in 2015 by Picador,
 
• It tells the story of three men and one woman and their experiences of life in Britain as illegal immigrants.
 
• The book received widespread critical acclaim upon publication and won the 2015 RSL Encore Award.
 
 
 
• **Shantaram - **
 
 
• Based directly upon the experiences of its author, Shantaram is the story of a man who escapes from a maximum security prison in Australia to arrive in Bombay, the crossroads of the underworld, where he works in a first-aid station and smuggles drugs and guns.​
